# Reviewed SHA-256 allowlist for the Ferrum Edge validator binary.
#
# Format: <64 lowercase hex sha256>  ferrum-edge-linux-x86_64  # <date/note>
#
# Upstream publishes production artifacts only for version tags. Assets on a
# given tag are immutable; a new version tag is a new candidate. GitHub's
# `/releases/latest` endpoint returns the newest non-draft, non-prerelease
# release and skips prereleases, so a retired rolling `latest` tag cannot
# starve versioned builds. Content is the only stable pin.
# `install-ferrum-edge.sh` resolves that candidate, verifies the publisher's
# own checksum, and then refuses to make the bytes executable unless the
# digest appears below.
#
# Keep one line per approved build. Retaining the previous line means a refresh
# does not break in-flight pull requests that still run against the older
# binary. Regenerate a line with:
#
#   bash .github/scripts/refresh-ferrum-edge-pin.sh --append
